title: Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan Credit Policy Standard: Approval, Decline Notice and Offer Disclosures
content:
## Standard

Underwriting approves a Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan application only when all of the following hold:

1. the worker meets the tier's entry gate of tenure and paychecks;
2. the worker is at least the product's minimum age;
3. the principal lies between the tier's smallest and largest principal;
4. the principal is within the tier's principal ceiling, stated as a percent of the worker's annualized gross pay;
5. the term is one of the terms the tier offers; and
6. the installment computed at the tier's APR fits within the tier's installment ceiling, stated as a percent of the worker's average net pay.

The tier is the one whose principal band contains the amount. A decline is followed by an adverse action notice within the product's notice period, counted in calendar days. An approved offer carries the Truth in Lending disclosures and stays open for the product's offer period, counted in calendar days.

## Tier figures this standard reads

The tier is fixed by the principal band, and the APR at which the installment is computed is the tier's own:

| Tier | Largest principal in the band | APR at which the installment is computed |
|---|---|---|
| Paystride Payroll Loan 500 | $500.00 | 24.99% |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 1000 | $1000.00 | 22.99% |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 2000 | $2000.00 | 19.99% |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 3000 | $3000.00 | 17.99% |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 4000 | $4000.00 | 15.99% |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 5000 | $5000.00 | 13.99% |

## Approval as a conjunction

Approval needs every one of the six conditions at once. An application that fails any one of them is not approved, however comfortably it meets the others.

| Tenure and paychecks met | Minimum age met | Principal inside the band | Within principal ceiling | Term offered by tier | Installment within ceiling | Approved |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |

## Worked application (hypothetical inputs)

A worker applies for $1200.00 over 12 months. The band containing $1200.00 is Paystride Payroll Loan 2000, so its entry gate, its ceilings, its offered terms and its APR of 19.99% are the ones read. Suppose the worker's annualized gross pay is $20000.00, so the principal ceiling at 8% is $1600.00 and $1200.00 is within it; 12 months is a term the tier offers; and the installment computed at 19.99% is a hypothetical $55.00 against a hypothetical average net pay of $600.00, whose 15% is $90.00, so the installment fits. If the worker also meets the tier's tenure and paychecks and the minimum age, every condition holds and the application is approved; the offer then carries the Truth in Lending disclosures and stays open for the offer period.

Had the same worker asked for 6 months, the term would not be one Paystride Payroll Loan 2000 offers, and the application would not be approved.

## After the decision

- **Decline:** an adverse action notice follows within the notice period, counted in calendar days from the decline.
- **Approval:** the offer carries the Truth in Lending disclosures and stays open for the offer period, counted in calendar days.
